purpose: Evidence-gated implementation coverage for the portable VCS Script VM reconstruction.

namespace.unimplemented_policy: Fault explicitly; never report a false script yield or invent a semantic name.

dispatcher.implementation: 16-bit little-endian fetch; advance IP by 2; store raw high NOT bit; dispatch raw_opcode & 0x7fff.

status_abi.0: CONTINUE: Process() immediately executes the next opcode.
status_abi.1: WAIT-specific YIELD: stop the current processing pass until wake_time.

implemented: raw int32 decoding for plural-collector tags 0x00..0x0A, including NUL-terminated ScriptSpace string offsets
VCS tag-0 split: plural collector produces raw zero while standalone CollectNextParameterWithoutIncreasingPC follows its low-variable resolver default
signed INT8/INT16 forms observed in PSP
thread-local, local-array, ScriptSpace-global and ScriptSpace-global-array references
array bound rejection matching the PSP resolver
output storage through decoded variable destinations
parameter_abi.boundary: The portable plural collector is a semantic loop over the directly confirmed PSP CollectParameters ABI rather than a binary copy of its coprocessor-assisted jump table; the function CALL/RETURN output ABI is separately proved.

handlers.name: NOP
handlers.contract: No script inputs, outputs or state effects; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: WAIT
handlers.contract: Read the evidenced immediate integer delay, set wake_time, clear wait_flag, native status 1/YIELD.

handlers.name: GOTO
handlers.contract: Read the evidenced immediate integer target, update script IP, native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: SET_VAR_INT
handlers.contract: Resolve destination, collect one raw dword and store it; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: SET_VAR_FLOAT
handlers.contract: Resolve destination, collect one raw dword and store it unchanged; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: SET_VAR_TEXT_LABEL
handlers.contract: Resolve destination, collect one raw parameter and store its dword; literal strings remain ScriptSpace offsets in the portable model; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: ADD_VAL_TO_INT_VAR
handlers.contract: Resolve destination, collect one dword and add modulo 2^32; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: ADD_VAL_TO_FLOAT_VAR
handlers.contract: Resolve destination, collect one raw binary32 value, add and store the raw binary32 result; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: SUB_VAL_FROM_INT_VAR
handlers.contract: Resolve destination, collect one dword, subtract modulo 2^32 and store; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: SUB_VAL_FROM_FLOAT_VAR
handlers.contract: Resolve destination, collect one raw binary32 value, subtract and store the raw binary32 result; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: MULT_INT_VAR_BY_VAL
handlers.contract: Resolve destination, collect one dword, store the low 32 bits of the product; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: MULT_FLOAT_VAR_BY_VAL
handlers.contract: Resolve destination, collect one raw binary32 value, multiply and store the raw binary32 result; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: DIV_INT_VAR_BY_VAL
handlers.contract: Resolve destination, collect one signed dword, divide for normal operands and store; reject zero divisor and INT_MIN/-1 instead of inventing a native edge quotient; native status 0/CONTINUE otherwise.

handlers.name: DIV_FLOAT_VAR_BY_VAL
handlers.contract: Resolve destination, collect one raw binary32 value, divide and store the raw binary32 result; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: IS_INT_VAR_GREATER_THAN_NUMBER
handlers.contract: Collect two signed int32 parameters, reduce param[0] > param[1] through raw NOT and the exact condition VM; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: IS_NUMBER_GREATER_THAN_INT_VAR
handlers.contract: Collect two signed int32 parameters, reduce param[0] > param[1] through raw NOT and the exact condition VM; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: IS_INT_VAR_GREATER_THAN_INT_VAR
handlers.contract: Collect two signed int32 parameters, reduce param[0] > param[1] through raw NOT and the exact condition VM; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: IS_FLOAT_VAR_GREATER_THAN_NUMBER
handlers.contract: Collect two raw binary32 parameters, reduce !(param[0] <= param[1]) through raw NOT and the exact condition VM; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: IS_NUMBER_GREATER_THAN_FLOAT_VAR
handlers.contract: Collect two raw binary32 parameters, reduce !(param[0] <= param[1]) through raw NOT and the exact condition VM; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: IS_FLOAT_VAR_GREATER_THAN_FLOAT_VAR
handlers.contract: Collect two raw binary32 parameters, reduce !(param[0] <= param[1]) through raw NOT and the exact condition VM; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: IS_INT_VAR_GREATER_OR_EQUAL_TO_NUMBER
handlers.contract: Collect two signed int32 parameters, reduce param[0] >= param[1] through raw NOT and the exact condition VM; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: IS_NUMBER_GREATER_OR_EQUAL_TO_INT_VAR
handlers.contract: Collect two signed int32 parameters, reduce param[0] >= param[1] through raw NOT and the exact condition VM; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: IS_INT_VAR_GREATER_OR_EQUAL_TO_INT_VAR
handlers.contract: Collect two signed int32 parameters, reduce param[0] >= param[1] through raw NOT and the exact condition VM; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: IS_FLOAT_VAR_GREATER_OR_EQUAL_TO_NUMBER
handlers.contract: Collect two raw binary32 parameters, reduce !(param[0] < param[1]) through raw NOT and the exact condition VM; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: IS_NUMBER_GREATER_OR_EQUAL_TO_FLOAT_VAR
handlers.contract: Collect two raw binary32 parameters, reduce !(param[0] < param[1]) through raw NOT and the exact condition VM; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: IS_FLOAT_VAR_GREATER_OR_EQUAL_TO_FLOAT_VAR
handlers.contract: Collect two raw binary32 parameters, reduce !(param[0] < param[1]) through raw NOT and the exact condition VM; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: IS_INT_VAR_EQUAL_TO_NUMBER
handlers.contract: Collect two signed int32 parameters, reduce param[0] == param[1] through raw NOT and the exact condition VM; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: IS_INT_VAR_EQUAL_TO_INT_VAR
handlers.contract: Collect two signed int32 parameters, reduce param[0] == param[1] through raw NOT and the exact condition VM; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: IS_FLOAT_VAR_EQUAL_TO_NUMBER
handlers.contract: Collect two raw dword parameters, reduce bitwise equality through raw NOT and the exact condition VM; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: IS_FLOAT_VAR_EQUAL_TO_FLOAT_VAR
handlers.contract: Collect two raw dword parameters, reduce bitwise equality through raw NOT and the exact condition VM; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: GOTO_IF_FALSE
handlers.contract: Read one script target; update IP only when condition_result is false; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: ADD_TIMED_VAL_TO_FLOAT_VAR
handlers.contract: Resolve destination, collect one raw binary32 parameter, multiply by host-provided engine time step, add and store raw result bits; native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing time-step provider faults explicitly. Exact shared target with 0032 on PSP and PS2.

handlers.name: ADD_TIMED_FLOAT_VAR_TO_FLOAT_VAR
handlers.contract: Exact PSP/PS2 dispatch alias of 0031: resolve destination, collect one raw binary32 parameter, add parameter * host time step and store; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: SUB_TIMED_VAL_FROM_FLOAT_VAR
handlers.contract: Resolve destination, collect one raw binary32 parameter, multiply by host-provided engine time step, subtract and store raw result bits; native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing time-step provider faults explicitly. Exact shared target with 0034 on PSP and PS2.

handlers.name: SUB_TIMED_FLOAT_VAR_FROM_FLOAT_VAR
handlers.contract: Exact PSP/PS2 dispatch alias of 0033: resolve destination, collect one raw binary32 parameter, subtract parameter * host time step and store; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: SET_VAR_INT_TO_VAR_INT
handlers.contract: Resolve destination, collect one raw dword and store it; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: SET_VAR_FLOAT_TO_VAR_FLOAT
handlers.contract: Resolve destination, collect one raw dword and store it unchanged; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: SET_VAR_TEXT_LABEL_TO_VAR_TEXT_LABEL
handlers.contract: Exact PSP/PS2 dispatch alias of 0006: resolve destination, collect one raw dword and store it; native status 0/CONTINUE. No host string-pointer ABI is asserted.

handlers.name: CSET_VAR_INT_TO_VAR_FLOAT
handlers.contract: Resolve destination and source variables; truncate source binary32 toward zero into destination int32; fault for NaN/infinity/out-of-range rather than invent a native FPU-invalid payload; native status 0/CONTINUE otherwise.

handlers.name: CSET_VAR_FLOAT_TO_VAR_INT
handlers.contract: Resolve destination and source variables; convert int32 to binary32 and store raw result bits; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: ABS_INT
handlers.contract: Resolve one int32 variable, conditional modulo-2^32 negate; INT_MIN remains INT_MIN; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: ABS_FLOAT
handlers.contract: Resolve one binary32 variable and negate only on strict < +0; -0 and NaN are preserved; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: START_NEW_SCRIPT
handlers.contract: Read one script index, clamp negative to zero, request a host-owned child thread, then decode and copy exactly 96 raw local dwords at child local slot zero; native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing/null host adapter faults explicitly.

handlers.name: GOSUB
handlers.contract: Collect one target parameter, push tagless post-parameter return IP at call depth, transfer to the evidenced script target convention, native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: RETURN
handlers.contract: Pop any frame. Tagless GOSUB frame restores its post-parameter return IP; CALL/CALL_NOT frames copy outputs from locals[LP + input_count], restore LP, StoreParameters into caller destinations and CALL_NOT flips condition_result; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: ADD_INT_VAR_TO_INT_VAR
handlers.contract: Resolve destination, collect one dword and add modulo 2^32; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: ARITHMETIC_DISPATCH_ALIAS_FLOAT_ADD
handlers.contract: Exact dispatch alias of 0008 on PSP and PS2: resolve destination, collect binary32, add, raw-result store; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: ARITHMETIC_DISPATCH_ALIAS_INTEGER_SUBTRACT
handlers.contract: Exact dispatch alias of 0009 on PSP and PS2: resolve destination, subtract modulo 2^32, store; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: ARITHMETIC_DISPATCH_ALIAS_FLOAT_SUBTRACT
handlers.contract: Exact dispatch alias of 000A on PSP and PS2: resolve destination, collect binary32, subtract, raw-result store; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: ARITHMETIC_DISPATCH_ALIAS_INTEGER_MULTIPLY
handlers.contract: Exact dispatch alias of 000B on PSP and PS2: resolve destination, store low 32 product bits; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: ARITHMETIC_DISPATCH_ALIAS_FLOAT_MULTIPLY
handlers.contract: Exact dispatch alias of 000C on PSP and PS2: resolve destination, collect binary32, multiply, raw-result store; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: ARITHMETIC_DISPATCH_ALIAS_INTEGER_DIVIDE
handlers.contract: Exact dispatch alias of 000D on PSP and PS2: normal signed division then store; reject zero divisor and INT_MIN/-1 rather than inventing a native edge quotient; native status 0/CONTINUE otherwise.

handlers.name: ARITHMETIC_DISPATCH_ALIAS_FLOAT_DIVIDE
handlers.contract: Exact dispatch alias of 000E on PSP and PS2: resolve destination, collect binary32, divide, raw-result store; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: IS_CHAR_STILL_ALIVE
handlers.contract: Collect one character handle, obtain an engine-owned liveness predicate from the host, apply raw NOT and the exact shared condition reducer; native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing probe faults explicitly.

handlers.name: CHARACTER_COORDINATE_PLACEMENT_BRIDGE
handlers.contract: Collect exactly one character handle plus three raw binary32 coordinate payloads. z == -100.0f or z <= -250.0f requests native ground-height resolution before the host placement path; otherwise pass raw coordinates directly. Native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing adapter faults explicitly.

handlers.name: VEHICLE_DELETE_BRIDGE
handlers.contract: Collect exactly one raw vehicle handle and forward it plus the observed native +0x20A context flag to the host vehicle-delete adapter; pool lookup, conditional cleanup-list removal, entity/reference removal and lifetime remain host-owned; native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing adapter faults explicitly.

handlers.name: RETURN_TRUE
handlers.contract: Apply exact condition reducer with base true, then execute the proved tagless/function RETURN core; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: CLEAR_PRINTS_BRIDGE
handlers.contract: Consume no SCM parameters, invoke the host native-print/UI clear path once and return native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing adapter faults explicitly.

handlers.name: RETURN_FALSE
handlers.contract: Apply exact condition reducer with base false, then execute the proved tagless/function RETURN core; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: IF
handlers.contract: Read one count, truncate to uint16 condition_state and for nonzero count seed result true for <9 / false for >=9; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: LAUNCH_MISSION
handlers.contract: Collect one mission ID, ask the host mission-launch adapter for a target script object, set the portable analogue of the directly observed target +0x20A launch-request byte, and return native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing/null host results fault explicitly.

handlers.name: IS_BUTTON_PRESSED
handlers.contract: Collect two raw parameters, truncate each to uint16 in source order, query a host input predicate, then apply raw NOT and the exact condition reducer. Native status 0/CONTINUE; missing probe faults explicitly.

handlers.name: SET_FADING_COLOUR
handlers.contract: Collect three dwords, narrow each to low uint8 and invoke host fade-colour adapter; native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing adapter faults explicitly.

handlers.name: DO_FADE
handlers.contract: Collect two dwords, normalize first <=2 to 0.0f otherwise float*0.001f, sign-narrow second to int16 and invoke host fade-start adapter; native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing adapter faults explicitly.

handlers.name: GET_FADING_STATUS
handlers.contract: Query host fade-status predicate without SCM parameters, apply raw NOT and exact shared condition reducer; native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing probe faults explicitly.

handlers.name: PLAYER_STATE_CODE_TWO_CONDITION
handlers.contract: Collect one raw player selector, query host predicate for the recovered native player state byte == 2, apply raw NOT and the exact shared condition reducer; native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing probe faults explicitly.

handlers.name: CHARACTER_DEAD_CONDITION
handlers.contract: Collect one raw character handle, query the host for the directly recovered multi-branch native dead-state predicate, apply raw NOT and the exact shared condition reducer; native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing probe faults explicitly.

handlers.name: GET_GAME_TIMER
handlers.contract: Copy injected game-clock raw dword into the one StoreParameters output destination; native status 0/CONTINUE. This is an output write, not an opcode return value.

handlers.name: PLAYER_CONTROL_BRIDGE
handlers.contract: Collect exactly two raw dwords, forward parameter 0 as the player-table selector and normalize parameter 1 by zero/non-zero into the host player-control adapter; native status 0/CONTINUE. Player safety, camera and reset branches remain host-owned; missing adapter faults explicitly.

handlers.name: VEHICLE_RELEASE_MARK_BRIDGE
handlers.contract: Collect exactly one raw vehicle handle and forward it plus the observed native +0x20A context flag to the host vehicle-release-mark adapter; pool lookup, release policy and context cleanup remain host-owned; native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing adapter faults explicitly. This is deliberately separate from destructive opcode 0049.

handlers.name: SET_UNIQUE_JUMPS_TOTAL
handlers.contract: Collect exactly one raw int32, forward it to the host-owned total-unique-jumps aggregate and return native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing host adapter faults explicitly; persistence and presentation remain host-owned.

handlers.name: CREATE_PICKUP_WITH_AMMO
handlers.contract: Collect exactly six values: model-object selector, pickup type (native low byte), ammo and x/y/z binary32. Apply the same negative-model and ground-Z rule as 013F, invoke the same host pickup constructor with ammo, then StoreParameters(1) for its handle; native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing host stages fault explicitly.

handlers.name: CREATE_PICKUP
handlers.contract: Collect exactly five values: model-object selector, pickup type (native low byte), x/y/z binary32. A negative model selector is resolved through a host-owned model-object table. For z == -100.0f or z <= -250.0f, query ground height then add native +0.5f. Invoke the host pickup constructor and StoreParameters(1) for its handle; native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing host stages fault explicitly.

handlers.name: GOSUB_FILE
handlers.contract: Collect exactly two raw parameters, push a tagless post-parameter return IP, transfer through parameter[0] with the proved script-target convention and return native status 0/CONTINUE. Parameter[1] is consumed but unobserved by the native handler; no file-loader meaning is claimed.

handlers.name: TERMINATE_THIS_SCRIPT
handlers.contract: No SCM parameters. Host performs the proven active-to-idle scheduler transfer and, for native +0x217-marked threads, clears the mission-running state. Core clears portable active state, marks the thread terminated and returns native status 1/YIELD. Missing adapter faults explicitly.

handlers.name: DISPLAY_TEXT
handlers.contract: Collect two raw binary32 coordinate payloads, then separately collect one raw text-key/offset payload and invoke the host display-text adapter; native status 0/CONTINUE. Text lookup, bounded UTF-16 queue and rendering remain host-owned; missing adapter faults explicitly.

handlers.name: SCRIPT_NAME
handlers.contract: Read one pointer-like ScriptSpace string source, copy exactly eight bytes with native strncpy semantics into the ScriptThread name field, lowercase only ASCII A..Z in all eight positions, native status 0/CONTINUE. Invalid portable sources fault explicitly.

handlers.name: CLEAR_HELP
handlers.contract: Consume no SCM parameters and invoke the host clear-help adapter once for the native two-path help/HUD clearing sequence; native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing adapter faults explicitly.

handlers.name: MISSION_STREAM_AND_IMMEDIATE_PROCESS_BOUNDARY
handlers.contract: The core-alone default decodes exactly one raw selector then faults explicitly. The separate VcsMissionHost may override this slot only with the recovered selector remap, offset-table range, scoped source-to-active-buffer copy, idle-to-active factory, post-finalizer target flags, mission-active/parsed-global clear and re-entrant Process(target) sequence. It forwards the first child VM/host fault rather than fabricating a successful mission. It must not be reduced to a generic launch callback.

handlers.name: IS_INT_VAR_EQUAL_TO_CONSTANT
handlers.contract: Collect two signed int32 parameters, reduce param[0] == param[1] through raw NOT and the exact condition VM; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: SET_VAR_INT_TO_CONSTANT
handlers.contract: Resolve destination, collect one raw dword and store it; native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: GET_PAD_STATE
handlers.contract: Read one raw selector. For unsigned selector 0..44 invoke host pad adapter and StoreParameters its raw result into one output destination; otherwise StoreParameters the selector unchanged. Native status 0/CONTINUE; missing in-range adapter faults explicitly.

handlers.name: CALL_NOT
handlers.contract: Decode the observed CALL header/inputs, push frame tag 0x00C00000, transfer IP, native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: CALL
handlers.contract: Decode the observed CALL header/inputs, push frame tag 0x00800000, transfer IP, native status 0/CONTINUE.

handlers.name: DISABLE_PAUSE_MENU
handlers.contract: Collect one raw dword, reduce it to zero/non-zero and invoke the host pause-menu toggle adapter with false/true; native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing adapter faults explicitly.

handlers.name: IS_THIS_SCRIPT_A_MISSION
handlers.contract: Read the portable semantic analogue of active ScriptThread native byte +0x217, apply raw NOT and the exact condition reducer, native status 0/CONTINUE. No SCM parameters or host adapter.

handlers.name: GLOBAL_BYTE_STORE_BRIDGE
handlers.contract: Collect exactly two raw dwords, forward parameter 0 as the engine-global byte-region offset and the low uint8 of parameter 1 to the host global-byte-store adapter; native status 0/CONTINUE. Missing adapter faults explicitly.

handlers.name: OPCODE_055A
handlers.contract: Apply base engine predicate XOR raw NOT bit; exact state 0 assignment, states 1..8 AND/decrement and states >=9 OR/decrement/reset semantics; native status 0/CONTINUE. Only the unnamed engine predicate is host-supplied.
